segments.source: frameSemantics
segments.ko: frameSemantics

segments.source: **Framework**: ARKit **Kind**: property
segments.ko: **Framework**: ARKit **Kind**: property

segments.source: The set of active semantics on the frame.
segments.ko: 프레임에서 활성화된 시맨틱 집합입니다.

segments.source: **Availability**:
segments.ko: **Availability**:

segments.source: iPadOS 13.0+
segments.ko: iPadOS 13.0+

segments.source: Mac Catalyst 13.1+
segments.ko: Mac Catalyst 13.1+

segments.source: Declaration
segments.ko: Declaration

segments.source: Discussion
segments.ko: Discussion

segments.source: You can choose whether ARKit reports information about a particular per-frame metric, or *semantic*.
segments.ko: If you don’t call [`prepareToPlay()`](avaudiosequencer/preparetoplay().md), the framework calls it and then starts the player.

segments.source: Before enabling a frame sementic, call [`supportsFrameSemantics(_:)`](arconfiguration/supportsframesemantics(_:).md) to ensure device support.
segments.ko: frame semantic을 활성화하기 전에 [`supportsFrameSemantics(_:)`](arconfiguration/supportsframesemantics(_:).md) 를 호출해 장치 지원을 확인합니다.

segments.source: Enable 2d Body Detection
segments.ko: 2D 바디 감지 활성화

segments.source: To get information about the 2D location of a person that ARKit recognizes in a frame, you enable the [`bodyDetection`](arconfiguration/framesemantics-swift.struct/bodydetection.md) frame semantic.
segments.ko: ARKit가 프레임에서 인식한 사람의 2D 위치 정보를 얻으려면 [`bodyDetection`](arconfiguration/framesemantics-swift.struct/bodydetection.md) frame semantic을 활성화합니다.

segments.source: Enable People Occlusion
segments.ko: 사람 오클루전 활성화

segments.source: People occlusion is a feature that enables people in the camera feed to cover your app’s virtual content.
segments.ko: 사람 오클루전은 카메라 피드의 사람이 앱의 가상 콘텐츠를 가리도록 해주는 기능입니다.

segments.source: ![Illustration showing two people standing in front of a virtual object.
segments.ko: ![가상 객체 앞에 서 있는 두 사람이 있는 카메라 피드를 보여주는 삽화.

segments.source: On the left, the person is partially occluded by the virtual object, breaking the illusion that the virtual object is actually placed in the physical environment.
segments.ko: 왼쪽에서 가상 객체가 사람의 일부를 가려, 가상 객체가 실제 물리 환경에 배치된 것처럼 보이는 착시가 깨집니다.

segments.source: On the right, the person occludes the virtual object which maintains the illusion that the virtual object is actually placed in the physical environment. ](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/5193e10c0631586408ee15a863543416/media-3541708%402x.png)
segments.ko: 오른쪽에서는 사람이 가상 객체를 가려서, 가상 객체가 실제 물리 환경에 배치된 것처럼 보이는 착시가 유지됩니다. ](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/5193e10c0631586408ee15a863543416/media-3541708%402x.png)

segments.source: To indicate that a person should overlap your app’s virtual content when the person is closer to the camera than the virtual content, add the [`personSegmentationWithDepth`](ARConfiguration/FrameSemantics-swift.struct/personSegmentationWithDepth.md) option to your configuration’s frame semantics.
segments.ko: 사람이 가상 콘텐츠보다 카메라에 더 가까울 때 사람의 콘텐츠가 앱의 가상 콘텐츠 위에 겹쳐 표시되어야 함을 나타내려면, 구성의 frame semantics에 [`personSegmentationWithDepth`](ARConfiguration/FrameSemantics-swift.struct/personSegmentationWithDepth.md) 옵션을 추가합니다.

segments.source: ![Screenshot of two people in the camera feed with a virtual object between them.
segments.ko: ![카메라 피드에 가상 객체가 사이에 있는 두 사람이 있는 스크린샷.

segments.source: The person who’s in front of the virtual object occludes the virtual object, and the person behind the virtual object is occluded by the virtual object.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/4b7f06d0108afa1d653dbe1dd5ffb8b1/media-3541707%402x.png)
segments.ko: 가상 객체 앞의 사람은 가상 객체를 가리고, 가상 객체 뒤의 사람은 가상 객체에 의해 가려집니다.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/4b7f06d0108afa1d653dbe1dd5ffb8b1/media-3541707%402x.png)

segments.source: To indicate that a person should overlap your app’s virtual content regardless of the person’s depth in the scene, use the [`personSegmentation`](arconfiguration/framesemantics-swift.struct/personsegmentation.md) frame semantic instead.
segments.ko: 사람이 장면 내에서 깊이값에 상관없이 앱의 가상 콘텐츠를 겹쳐 표시해야 함을 나타내려면 [`personSegmentation`](arconfiguration/framesemantics-swift.struct/personsegmentation.md) frame semantic을 대신 사용합니다.

segments.source: This option is particularly appropriate for green-screen scenarios.
segments.ko: 이 옵션은 특히 그린 스크린 시나리오에 적합합니다.

segments.source: ![Screenshot of two people in the camera feed standing in front of a virtual background.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/13df4f15a3ec26839e6ce6e088661bd9/media-3541705%402x.png)
segments.ko: ![카메라 피드에서 두 사람이 가상 배경 앞에 서 있는 스크린샷.](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/13df4f15a3ec26839e6ce6e088661bd9/media-3541705%402x.png)

segments.source: Standard renderers ([`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView), and [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md)) implement people occlusion for you.
segments.ko: 표준 렌더러([`ARView`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/RealityKit/ARView), 및 [`ARSCNView`](arscnview.md))가 people occlusion을 대신 구현합니다.

segments.source: See [`Occluding virtual content with people`](occluding-virtual-content-with-people.md) for a sample app that demonstrates people occlusion in RealityKit.
segments.ko: [`Occluding virtual content with people`](occluding-virtual-content-with-people.md)에서 RealityKit의 사람 오클루전을 시연하는 샘플 앱을 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: If you implement your own renderer, use [`segmentationBuffer`](arframe/segmentationbuffer.md) and [`estimatedDepthData`](arframe/estimateddepthdata.md) to implement people occlusion yourself.
segments.ko: 직접 렌더러를 구현하는 경우 사람 오클루전을 직접 구현하려면 [`segmentationBuffer`](arframe/segmentationbuffer.md) 및 [`estimatedDepthData`](arframe/estimateddepthdata.md)를 사용합니다.

segments.source: [`ARMatteGenerator`](armattegenerator.md) helps you by providing masks.
segments.ko: [`ARMatteGenerator`](armattegenerator.md) 는 마스크를 제공하여 이를 지원합니다.

segments.source: For a sample app that demonstrates matte generator and people occlusion, see [`Effecting People Occlusion in Custom Renderers`](effecting-people-occlusion-in-custom-renderers.md).
segments.ko: 마스크 생성기와 사람 오클루전을 보여주는 샘플 앱은 [`Effecting People Occlusion in Custom Renderers`](effecting-people-occlusion-in-custom-renderers.md)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: If you enable Scene Reconstruction, ARKit adjusts the mesh according to any people ARKit may detect in the camera feed.
segments.ko: Scene Reconstruction을 활성화하면 ARKit는 카메라 피드에서 감지한 사람을 기준으로 메시를 조정합니다.

segments.source: ARKit removes any part of the scene mesh that overlaps with people, as defined by the with- or without-depth frame semantics.
segments.ko: ARKit는 depth 포함 또는 미포함 frame semantics로 정의된 대로 장면 메시 중 사람과 겹치는 부분을 제거합니다.

segments.source: For more information about scene reconstruction, see [`Visualizing and interacting with a reconstructed scene`](visualizing-and-interacting-with-a-reconstructed-scene.md).
segments.ko: 장면 재구성에 대한 자세한 내용은 [`Visualizing and interacting with a reconstructed scene`](visualizing-and-interacting-with-a-reconstructed-scene.md)를 참고합니다.
